env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^51 <nil>$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
grep '/\* a \*/' out/main.go
grep '/\* b \*/' out/main.go
grep '// c' out/main.go
grep '/\* e \*/' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/stagerangehead

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

func double(ctx context.Context, x int) (int, error) {
	return 2 * x, nil
}

func sum(ctx context.Context, xs []int) (int, error) {
	total := 0
	for y := /* a */ range xs.group(ctx, limit = 2).map(x => double(ctx, x)?) {
		total += y
	}
	for z /* b */ := range xs.group(ctx, limit = 2).map(x => double(ctx, x)?) {
		total += z
	}
	for w := // c
		range xs.group(ctx, limit = 2).map(x => double(ctx, x)?) {
		total += w
	}
	var v int
	for v = /* e */ range xs.group(ctx, limit = 2).map(x => double(ctx, x)?) {
		total += v
	}
	for /* d */ range xs.group(ctx, limit = 2).map(x => double(ctx, x)?) {
		total++
	}
	return total, nil
}

func main() {
	n, err := sum(context.Background(), []int{1, 2, 3})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(n, err)
}
